name: node
description: trailbeam (Node.js) client hooks on @aws-sdk/client-sqs v3, from this checkout's node/ (run `npm ci` there first).

variants.name: alone
variants.about: only Trailbeam: install() and instrument(client), no other tracing

variants.name: app-otel
variants.about: the application's own provider and the stock @opentelemetry/instrumentation-aws-sdk, registered first

variants.name: app-otel-sampled-0
variants.about: as app-otel, with the application's sampler at 0%: Trailbeam's always-on provider must still export every span

variants.name: capture
variants.about: body capture on for every queue (contract 15): every send and receive must carry the body
